note: Close-up of the grandparents' mantelpiece (s02maison repaint 2026-10-22): olive damask wallpaper and dark wainscot as in the parlour, gilt overmantel mirror, brass mantel clock, white carved marble fireplace with a log fire and brass fender. Every word here is feminine, so the whole shelf is the feminine side: granddaughter feeding grandma's pink piggy bank (petite-fille), father in a patterned apron pouring tea while holding a newborn (paternité), wife posing on her husband's arm (épouse), the whole kin round one tea table (parenté), mother hen with her adopted duckling (adoption), bride ringing a brass bell (belle-fille), and in the open album a stern stepmother on her beautiful grey mare (belle-mère). No painted exit (gate 8): the Back control returns to the parlour.
